what: A read of every run that made at least one claim, looking for a statement about the investigated line (what it is, what it does, or why it is the way it is) that no collected source supports. It is separate from the pass or fail of a case: the automatic checks do not read the claims. In this run the writer was shown the line and what the last change did to it, so a statement about the line can also come from there. Those are listed apart, under fromTheCode, after checking each against the code and the patch.
reader: Drafted with an AI assistant from the raw runs, the collected evidence, the code shown to the model and the patches of the commits involved. Not checked by a second person.
